basic_info.description: Discover unparalleled elegance at 38 Steiner Street, Unit 303, located in the vibrant heart of San Francisco. This exquisite top-floor flat, with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, has been meticulously remodeled and seismically updated in 2021, offering a sophisticated retreat. Tucked at the rear of the building, Unit 303 features a secluded private deck, perfect for tranquil moments. With its wide plank flooring, the open-plan living area is awash with natural light, leading seamlessly into a chef's kitchen. Here, culinary dreams come to life with top-of-the-line appliances, including a Thermador built-in fridge, induction cooktop, and microwave drawer, all elegantly complemented by a spacious kitchen island. Retreat to the primary suite with an elegant walk-in shower and double vanity, while additional bathrooms feature Porcelanosa tile and LED vanity mirrors. Lots of smart home features throughout the property, such as radiant heating and Lutron lighting controls. In-unit Washer and Dryer completes the picture. Conclude your day with breathtaking panoramic views on the shared roof deck, capturing the essence of San Francisco living. Embrace the luxury and vibrant lifestyle of Duboce Park and Hayes Valley.
